sources.authors: L. H. Conrad-Marut; E. W. Reinheimer; A. R. Johnson
sources.title: Synthesis and structure determination of racemic (Delta/Lambda)-tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) trichloride hemi(hexaaquasodium chloride)
sources.notes: Extract only [Co(en)3]3+. Co lies on a threefold axis; expand symmetry. Remove chloride and the hydrated sodium unit; retain both enantiomer possibilities in evaluation.

sources.authors: C.-C. Kong; J.-Z. Zhou; J.-H. Yu; S.-L. Li
sources.title: Crystal structure of dichlorido(2,2':6',2''-terpyridine-kappa3N,N',N'')zinc: a redetermination
sources.notes: Neutral five-coordinate molecule. The paper describes a distorted square pyramid; preserve the experimental distortion rather than idealizing it.

sources.authors: A. G. Oliver; T.-L. E. Lockwood; J. Zinna; M. Lieberman
sources.title: Bis(N,N-diethyl-4-methyl-4-piperazine-1-carboxamide) tetrakis(isothiocyanato-kappaN)cobalt(II), a model compound for the blue color developed in the Scott test
sources.notes: Extract only [Co(NCS)4]2-, with N-bound thiocyanate. The bulky organic cations are spectators.

sources.authors: K. Siddikova; D. Ziyatov; A. Tojiboev; J. Ashurov; Z. Kadirova; S. Daminova
sources.title: Synthesis, crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface analysis of bis(acetylacetonato-kappa2O,O')(2-amino-1-methyl-1H-benzimidazole-kappaN3)copper(II)
sources.notes: Neutral five-coordinate molecule. Coordinate through the pyridine-like benzimidazole N, not the amino or methylated N. Publication year is 2025 although the deposited CIF header says 2024.

sources.authors: O. E. Piro; G. A. Echeverria; E. J. Baran
sources.title: Spontaneous enantiomorphism in poly-phased alkaline salts of tris(oxalato)ferrate(III): crystal structure of cubic NaRb5[Fe(C2O4)3]2
sources.notes: Use P4332 as the nominated anchor; P4132 is the enantiomeric crystal, not an independent case. Extract the Fe first-shell tris-chelate and remove Na/Rb contacts. High-spin S=5/2 is discussed in the paper.

sources.authors: D.-X. Li; D.-J. Xu; Y.-Z. Xu
sources.title: Redetermination of bis(dimethylglyoximato-kappa2N,N')nickel(II)
sources.notes: COD mirror provides the archival CIF. Isolated neutral molecule with N,N chelation. Proton localization and oxime stereochemistry need special care; heavy-atom comparison alone does not validate them.

sources.authors: C. Krebs; I. Jess; C. Nather
sources.title: Syntheses and crystal structures of the ethanol, acetonitrile and diethyl ether Werner clathrates bis(isothiocyanato-kappaN)tetrakis(3-methylpyridine-kappaN)nickel(II)
sources.notes: Nominate datablock 1 (ethanol solvate). Strip uncoordinated ethanol. Other solvates are not additional independent cases.

sources.authors: R. A. Adrian; H. D. Arman
sources.title: Bis(4'-chloro-2,2':6',2''-terpyridine-kappa3N,N',N'')zinc(II) bis(trifluoromethanesulfonate)
sources.notes: Extract the dication; remove triflate. The covalently bound chlorine substituents belong to the ligands and are retained. The structure was refined as a two-component twin.
